async def act(page):
    # Fill the textbox to trigger user suggestions for 'Koushik'
    textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Select members to invite")
    await textbox.fill("Koushik")
    # Wait for potential dropdown to appear
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
    # Check if the user option 'Koushik Dutta @koush' is available and select it
    user_option = page.get_by_role("option", name="Koushik Dutta @koush")
    if await user_option.is_visible():
        await user_option.click()
    # Wait for the button to potentially enable
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)
    # Click the 'Add to project' button to invite Koushik as a guest
    button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Add to project")
    await button.click()
